name: Izumo no Okuni
source:
Died at the age of 24.

One of the escapees from Hell. Worshipped by the women of Hell as someone who managed to fulfill a famous legend, where a woman is carried by the man they love over the Sanzu River.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/izumo-no-okuni/]Aksys Games[/url]]
